rules: Use IBM Plex Mono for all prices (e.g., ₺ 149.90) to ensure tabular lining and perfect vertical alignment in the UI.
Headings should use tracking-tight for a precise, technical feel.
Label print layouts MUST use high-legibility fonts (IBM Plex Sans) with pure black color for crisp printing.
Avoid using 'Inter' for headings to maintain a distinctive look.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Use stark contrast for the data table to ensure high scanability.
Borders should be crisp (1px solid border) instead of heavy shadows. This gives a utilitarian, inventory-focused feel.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use 1px borders instead of heavy drop shadows to create structure.
visual_enhancers.borders: Square or very slightly rounded (rounded-md max) for a utilitarian feel. The 'Grid Borders' micro-theme is highly recommended for the dashboard.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid flat colors. No glassmorphism in the main dashboard to keep the data clear. Use flat backgrounds with a hard bottom border for headers.

components.buttons: Sharp rectangular or slightly rounded-md. Solid primary color for main actions (Etiket Bas, Ürün Ekle).
components.table: High-density data table. Compact rows (h-12 or 48px). Sticky header. Right-align pricing. Fixed checkbox column on the left for bulk selection.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI standard inputs, customized with crisp borders and square corners.
components.toasts: Use 'sonner' for all success/error notifications (e.g., 'Ürün eklendi', 'Giriş başarısız').

layouts.login: Split screen. Left: Login form centered vertically and horizontally. Right: Full height image of a minimalist retail store.
layouts.dashboard: Sidebar navigation (narrow) + expansive main content area for the data table. Ensure the table takes up maximum width.
layouts.print_preview: A dedicated hidden or modal route that visually represents an A4 page using strict millimeter measurements. It must render perfectly when window.print() is called.

print_css_rules.container: width: 210mm; min-height: 297mm; padding: 14mm 5mm; display: grid; gap: 0; box-sizing: border-box; background: white;
print_css_rules.label_style: display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; border: 1px dashed #e5e7eb; box-sizing: border-box; overflow: hidden; page-break-inside: avoid;
print_css_rules.hide_ui: @media print { body * { visibility: hidden; } .print-section, .print-section * { visibility: visible; } .print-section { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; } }

motion.hover: Subtle background shifts on table rows.
motion.transitions: Fast (150ms) ease-in-out for buttons. Do not use 'transition: all' as it breaks transforms.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially prices and labels, passes WCAG AA standards.
accessibility.data_testids: MANDATORY on all buttons, inputs, form submissions, and table rows (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='print-labels-btn').

media.icons: lucide-react (Clean and standard for admin interfaces)

instructions_to_main_agent: Language MUST be strictly Turkish everywhere (Giriş Yap, Ürünler, Etiket Bas, Ürün Adı, Fiyat, Stok vs.).
Currency MUST be Turkish Lira (₺) formatted correctly (e.g., 150.00 ₺).
The core value of this app is the PRINTING FUNCTIONALITY. You MUST implement a dedicated Print area using the exact CSS rules provided in 'print_css_rules'.
Full Label specifications: 100mm width x 30mm height. (Total 16 per A4 sheet, arranged in 2 columns and 8 rows).
Half Label specifications: 50mm width x 30mm height. (Total 36 per A4 sheet, arranged in 4 columns and 9 rows).
Labels should ONLY display Product Name and Price. Do not include barcodes or QR codes.
Implement a robust data table for product tracking with add, edit, delete capabilities. Pre-fill with some dummy Turkish retail products.
Allow selecting multiple products via checkboxes to print them in bulk. Include a global 'Select All' checkbox.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the Print layout (avoid complex Shadcn components inside the printable area to prevent injected layout issues).
Ensure the login screen requires a username and password (dummy validation is fine, but the flow must exist).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends. Avoid 'AI slop'.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder images like via.placeholder.com. Use the provided image URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing Shadcn components. Use sonner for toasts.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions). Static = dead.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
